rules.name: Devotees of Tyranny
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
The model gains Fearless and Frenzy while Engaged in Combat. In addition, units consisting entirely of models with Devotees of Tyranny and, if applicable, a Drum Gogyag, may reroll failed Charge Range rolls in the Charge Phase.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Divine Attacks, Flaming Attacks, Harnessed, Impact Hits (D3)

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains Lightning Reflexes while using this weapon. In addition, single model units that have suffered one or more Health Point losses due to attacks from this weapon suffer −1 Resilience and −1 Attack Value until the end of the Combat Phase.
